scope: Two serial bounded source/official-public-document inspection commands only, no build/test/Git/CI or class execution. Exact cached public KGP artifact is immutable input; no cache deletion. javap disassembles named class bytes without initializing them.
limits: javap JVM heap256MiB; each child25s with original-direct-child kill/wait5s on timeout/interruption; stdout4MiB javap/2MiBcurl expected bound; curl maxfilesize2MiB/max-time20; no retry. Minimal environment clears Java agent/options and curl-q prevents local curlrc.
cleanup: Install termination handlers before launch; finally reap only original child/close pipes. Retain compact exact public outputs/results; no temporary namespace, Gradle/cache/application launch or wrapper stop applies. SIGKILL/kernel block may prevent cleanup; never infer global idle.
